Repair and extend the offline residential IPv6 campaign toolkit.
The multi-file Python workspace is in `/workspace/submission`.
Its generator, compressed capture classifier and device protocol adapters
must support the campaign interface specified in `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md`.
Implement revision-aware evidence reconciliation across prefix leases,
a causal service census, and an optimal quota-constrained follow-up plan.
Return the target manifest, rejected-record indices, snapshot reports,
request activity, and a checkable probe-script certificate.
All input addresses are documentation addresses; never contact targets.
Read `/workspace/SYSCALLS.md` for the exact child and checker-parent profiles.
Pinned dependencies are bundled; runtime and checks require no network.
Submit the entire `/workspace/submission` directory, with `campaign.py`
as its entry point. You may change, add or reorganize ordinary files.
The entry point receives one UTF-8 JSON object on stdin and writes one
UTF-8 JSON object on stdout. Other output belongs on stderr.
Run `python3 /workspace/public_check.py /workspace/submission` for sanity checks.
The public examples cover only a small part of the stated domain.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
